name: Lightning Retribution
descriptionTemplate: Randomly deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG [Arg2] {plural:[Arg2]|time|times}, with a [Arg3]% {Tentacle DMG} Bonus, and each time DMG is dealt, target's {Tentacle DMG} taken this turn +[Arg4]%. Add [Arg5] copies of {derived:Pilot} into hand. {Aftershock}: this card returns to the top of the Draw Pile.
lore:
Even when angry, Corposant remains rational.
She will first evaluate the mistake made by the other party and then calculate the appropriate level of punishment based on its severity.
For in the vast ocean, without order, killing and betrayal would devour everything.
